G023: Epidote crystal chip: olive-green short cluster of TWO unequal sharply prismatic crystals with strong lengthwise grooves and slanted terminations, angular rather than rounded.
G028: Apatite grain: pale teal-green small stubby HEXAGONAL barrel crystal with flat hexagon top and vertical side faces, no pointed quartz tip.
G029: Topaz tumbled fragment: transparent honey-yellow elongated block with one broad flat cleavage face, worn rounded corners and clear internal pale facets.
G030: Tourmaline column fragment: long charcoal-green triangular-prism crystal with TWO broad grooved faces, blunt broken top and strongly longitudinal striations, not needle bundle.
G031: Kyanite blade: narrow flattened deep blue long rectangular crystal blade, ragged fibrous tip and parallel straight lengthwise stripes, pale blue reflective center.
G032: Sillimanite fibrous aggregate: fan-like bundle of many slender cream-gray parallel crystal needles joined at one narrow base and fraying at wide broken end, no smooth rock.
G033: Andalusite prism chip: stout pinkish-brown square column with blunt end showing a bold dark cross-shaped inclusion, lengthwise beveled edges, not faceted gem.
G034: Staurolite crystal fragment: TWO brown short rectangular prismatic crystals naturally intersecting in a clear diagonal X cross, thick rough faces and angular tips.
G039: Chromite grain: compact dark brown-black angular octahedral grain, broad matte triangular facets and muted metallic edge, chunky equant form.
G040: Cassiterite grain: dark brown glossy short prismatic crystal with TWO slanted pyramidal end faces, reddish amber edge, clearly angular stepped growth ridges.
G044: Barite tabular fragment: stack of three pale cream thin broad rectangular plate crystals, stepped overlapping edges and pearly flat faces, horizontal fan arrangement.
G046: Siderite grain: honey-brown rhombohedral crystal with curved saddle-like broad faces and sharp slanted corners, small attached second rhomb below.
G050: Bornite chip: squat angular copper-ore fragment with large muted blue-violet and copper-bronze surface patches and crisp faceted breaks; no sparkle or neon glow.
G051: Pyrrhotite grain: bronze-brown flattened hexagonal metallic plate, rough chipped edge and layered dark side, low rectangular profile, not cube cluster.
G052: Galena grain: dense lead-gray metallic STEP-CUBE cluster with three right-angle staircase cleavage blocks, strong square faces and silver edge highlights.
G053: Sphalerite chip: dark resinous amber-brown sharply angular cluster with triangular reflective cleavage faces and one warm translucent pointed corner, not gold metal.
G054: Malachite on matrix: jagged dark gray host rock with bright green layered botryoidal rounded copper-mineral crust on ONE side, two curved concentric green bands.
G089: Flaky placer gold: THREE separate very thin jagged irregular gold flakes, one large curled scallop and two smaller slivers, visible gaps, much thinner than nugget.
G091: Rounded placer gold: ONE small smooth asymmetrical bean-shaped gold grain with worn bulbous edges and shallow dents, no sharp crystal faces or multiple particles.
G097: Placer gold trapped in heavy minerals: small dense group of FOUR dark angular heavy-mineral grains touching around ONE tiny visible gold sliver at center, no sand background.
G041: Zircon grain: small reddish cinnamon transparent crystal with short tetragonal prism and paired sharp pyramidal terminations, hard angular silhouette and pale facet on upper left.
G042: Monazite grain: tiny honey-ochre irregular wedge crystal with one broad slanted flat face and short beveled edges, warm resinous luster, no glow.
G043: Scheelite chip: pale honey-cream chunky crystal with broad triangular faces forming squat double pyramid, dark mineral inclusion on one lower corner, no fluorescence.
G045: Celestite small crystal: pale icy blue elongated prismatic crystal with broad flat blade face and beveled chisel termination, one smaller offset crystal attached at base.
G047: Rhodochrosite chip: rose-pink rhombohedral crystal cleavage block, distinct slanted planar faces with thin cream band across one face, not rounded pink pebble.
G048: Rhodonite tumbled fragment: irregular rounded dusty pink slab with branching BLACK manganese vein network on broad face, one broken angular corner.
G055: Azurite attached to matrix: compact dark rock shard with TWO deep rich blue angular crystal rosettes and tiny green edge stain, no luminous glow.
G056: Native copper grain: ONE irregular branching copper metallic nugget with blunt forked protrusions, warm reddish metal and one dark oxidation crease, no quartz host.
G057: Native silver on matrix: small charcoal-gray angular host rock with curled wirelike SILVER crystalline strands crossing the top and projecting from edge, not a jewelry chain.
G058: Corundum grain: dull ruby-purple compact six-sided barrel crystal with thick flat top and stepped basal growth lines, no jewelry cut.
G059: Spinel grain: dark red-brown sharply OCTAHEDRAL single crystal, two joined square pyramids forming clear pointed diamond outline, broad triangular facets.
G085: Native gold with quartz vein: angular white quartz rock fragment traversed by ONE thick irregular bright gold branching VEIN, visible host rock and metallic seam, not loose nugget.
G086: Native gold in quartz cavity: pale quartz shard with large DARK central geode-like hollow, a small hooked gold growth visible INSIDE cavity, rough crystal rim.
G087: Native gold on iron oxide: rusty red-brown porous host rock with TWO flattened gold patches clinging to protruding ridges, angular ochre substrate clearly dominant.
G090: Folded placer gold: ONE thin gold flake folded twice like a tiny crumpled ribbon, clear overlapping layers and dark fold gaps, not a smooth nugget.
G092: Porous native gold: ONE compact irregular lacy gold nugget with THREE large open dark through-holes and knobby ligaments, honeycomb silhouette.
G093: Dendritic native gold: flat open branching tree-like gold growth with central stem and FOUR uneven side branches, large transparent gaps, not a round lump.
G094: Wire native gold: ONE long slender naturally crooked gold wire in loose S curve with small hooked fork at end, narrow metallic strand, no jewelry links.
G095: Native gold with crystal faces: compact gold crystal specimen composed of THREE angular intersecting faceted blocks with broad flat triangular faces and sharp ridges, not rounded placer.
G096: Thin film native gold: low flat dark quartz schist chip with a delicate broad irregular GOLD FOIL patch conforming to upper surface, torn thin edges, host clearly visible.
G099: Microgold on quartz grain: ONE small angular milky white quartz crystal grain with tiny TWO gold pinhead flecks attached on one edge, mostly white quartz, not large gold vein.
G100: Flattened natural gold nugget: large broad asymmetrical flattened oval pancake nugget, thick softly worn edges, shallow pockmarks and rounded lobes, no crystalline points or host rock.
